findings.finding: The only consensus row (FY2026 non-GAAP EPS 4.12, n=51) is a pre-Q3 snapshot dated 2026-10-17 from an aggregator (Chartmill) that does not name its data provider, retrieved as a search excerpt. low and high were set equal to the mean 'only to satisfy the schema' (numbers note), so the row shows zero dispersion that was never observed. The 'non-GAAP' basis label is also not supported: the lane's own note says the basis is not stated.
findings.fix: Remove low/high (or mark them unknown) so no invented dispersion is carried. Label the basis 'unstated' and the row 'pre-Q3 2026 report, stale'. Do not use it as the post-results expectation. Show it next to the result as a stale, single-aggregator expectation and keep 'no post-Q3 attributed consensus' as a visible gap.

findings.finding: The guidance track record is entered twice with different units and coverage. numbers.json lists 6 rows in USD millions (e.g. guided_mid 2997.5) and leaves out Q2 2026. documents.json lists 7 rows in USD (2997500000.0), including Q2 2026 (guided 3815-3820 from dc_rel_20260422 = gather/raw_documents/erq1fy26.txt; actual 3877). ticker-check returns track_record null for both fragments, so the engine has not computed the ratio. I checked every guided midpoint and actual against the saved releases and they are correct. The numbers lane's ratios (1.0025, 1.0266, 1.0112, 1.0120, 1.0051, 1.0026) match my recomputation, but its claim that the 'Q2 2026 guide is not in the saved releases' is wrong: the documents lane saved it (ratio 3877/3817.5 = 1.0156).
findings.where: gather/numbers.json guidance_track (all rows) vs gather/documents.json guidance_track (all rows)
findings.fix: Keep one track (the documents lane owns guidance, in USD) and drop or convert the numbers-lane rows so the merge does not hold duplicate rows in mixed units. Recompute the mean beat over 7 periods (about 1.012, 7 beats, 0 misses). Then confirm that ticker-check / the merged pack reports a non-null track_record.

findings.finding: The prefetched share history mixes split bases. shares_diluted_wavg for FY2020-FY2024 (202.5M-208.4M) is pre-split, while FY2025 (1,046.7M) is after the 5-for-1 split effective 2025-12-18. The same applies to EPS for FY2020-FY2024 in companyfacts. Any share-count CAGR, dilution rate or per-share history taken from these facts without adjustment shows a false ~400% dilution in 2025.
findings.where: gather/_prefetch.json facts pf_shares_diluted_wavg_fy2020..fy2024 (and the matching EPS facts)
findings.fix: Multiply pre-2025 share counts by 5 and divide pre-2025 EPS by 5 before any dilution or per-share history is used (the numbers lane already did this for its P/E history). Alternatively, use the split-adjusted comparatives in the FY2025 10-K and the Q3 2026 10-Q (Q3 2025 diluted 1,048M, 9M 2025 1,047M). Put a split note on the facts.

findings.finding: The price source is dated 2026-10-31 (a Saturday), but the IB snapshot's own timestamp is 1793404772 = 2026-10-30 23:59:32 UTC with is_close=false. 105.34 is therefore the last print of Friday 2026-10-30, possibly after-hours, and not necessarily the official close. It is citable either way, since it is dated before as_of.
findings.fix: Date the source 2026-10-30, its actual timestamp. Optionally confirm the 2026-10-30 regular-session close with one read-only get_price_history call and use it if it differs.

findings.finding: The guidance_track source_ids for Q1 2025 cite only the reporting release (pf_rel_20250423_1). The guiding release (Q4 2024 results, 2025-01-29, 'Subscription revenues $2,995 - $3,000') is saved but not cited.
findings.fix: Add the 2025-01-29 release (reading/release_2025-01-29__erq4fy24.txt, its pf_rel id) to source_ids as the guiding document.

findings.finding: The ERP of 4.2% (Damodaran, 2026-10-01) was implied against a 5.29% treasury, while the risk-free used is 4.98% (FRED DGS10, 2026-10-29). The pair is not on one date and one treasury basis.
findings.fix: Note the mismatch next to the discount rate. If the engine pairs the ERP with its own treasury convention, document that pairing. Otherwise leave as is: this is a market price of risk, not a company input.

findings.finding: The 9M 2026 SBC fact (1,829) is the cash-flow-statement figure. The non-GAAP reconciliation in the same release uses 1,846 (633 for Q3). Both are correct on their own basis, but they differ.
findings.fix: Label the basis as 'cash flow statement'. When the non-GAAP to GAAP operating bridge is built, use 1,846 / 633.
